newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index slightly down in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index slightly down in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly down by 0.09 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 499.12 from 499.58 points on Monday.
Total volume was 1.39 million dinars against 591,354 dinars over the previous session. Turnover in over-the-counter exchanges represented about half of the total.
Chemical firm Al-Kimia dropped 3.94 dinars to 46.44 dinars with only 50 shares changing hands.
UBCI bank fell 0.62 dinar to 50.18 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat edged lower 0.48 dinar to 19.2. Amen Bank slid 0.4 dinar to 36.6 dinars. BTEI bank was down 0.2 dinar to 22.8.
Palm Beach Hotels declined 0.3 dinar to 11 dinars.
Banque de Tunisie won one dinar to 76 dinars. UIB bank rose 0.13 dinar to 12.53.
Detergents firm SPCD was up 0.2 dinar to 37 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF advanced 0.2 dinar to 17.3. Retail stores Monoprix was up 0.18 dinar to 37.8 dinars.
Most of the trade was in Banque Nationale Agricole with 10,000 shares changing hands at the unchanged price of 30 dinars. ($1= 1.09 dinar)
